FN-G58V262-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 123
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 123 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Auctioneers
until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
